resources.string: EraseAI Firewall uses Android Accessibility permission only to inspect text you are actively entering in selected AI apps, so it can warn or redact sensitive data before it is sent. Password fields are skipped. Optional Strict network gate (Settings) routes protected AI apps through a local VPN to block sends at the network layer — it does not decrypt HTTPS traffic.
EraseAI is blocking AI app network
A risky prompt is held. Approve or discard in the app to restore connectivity.
